landingMinProducts.title: Products in stock to index
landingMinProducts.description: A landing page set to Automatic is indexed by search engines while at least this many of its products are in stock.

landingUrl.title: Landing page address
landingUrl.description: Where a landing page is on your website: {categoryUrl} (its category's page), {category}, {brand} and {grade}, for example {categoryUrl}?brand={brand}&grade={grade}. Empty values are left out.

attributeUrl.title: Attribute glossary address
attributeUrl.description: Where an attribute's glossary page is on your website, with {slug}, for example /glossary/{slug}. Empty: there are no attribute glossary pages (they are left out of the sitemap).

gradeUrl.title: Grade glossary address
gradeUrl.description: Where a grade's glossary page is on your website, with {key}, for example /grades/{key}. Empty: there are no grade glossary pages (they are left out of the sitemap).
